summary: The UK government has responded to a House of Lords report on artificial intelligence, outlining their plan to address concerns and capitalize on AI opportunities. The response aims to provide a framework for ensuring AI is developed and used responsibly in the UK.

title: Defence Artificial Intelligence Strategy
description: Our vision is that, in terms of AI, we will be the world’s most effective, efficient, trusted and influential Defence organisation for our size.
summary: The Defence Artificial Intelligence Strategy aims to make the Defence organisation the most effective, efficient, trusted, and influential in AI for its size. By achieving this vision, they plan to leverage AI to enhance their capabilities and outcomes.

title: Transport artificial intelligence action plan
description: Sets out how DfT will work with the transport sector to exploit the opportunities from AI while managing potential risks.
summary: This document outlines the Department for Transport's plan to harness the potential benefits of artificial intelligence in the transport sector while mitigating potential risks and challenges. The plan aims to leverage AI technology to improve transport efficiency, safety, and customer experience while working closely with the industry.
